name: Biomedix Medical
old_description: Full service – sale, repair, lease, and purchase of used equipment.
about:
Biomedix Medical operates from Avondale, Pennsylvania, as a Pennsylvania corporation specializing in service-based medical equipment support. The company serves EMS, homecare, hospital, and veterinary clinic customers across the United States, its territories, Canada, and Mexico.

The business provides full-service sale, repair, lease, and purchase of used medical equipment. Its repair capabilities cover infusion pumps, syringe pumps, feeding pumps, defibrillators, pulse oximeters, patient monitors, SCD pumps, and transport and portable ventilators. The company also buys, sells, rents, and leases surplus medical equipment, and offers preventative maintenance and service programs. Product categories include ambulatory pumps, disposables, feeding pumps, infusion pumps (33 models), parts and accessories (20 models), SCD pumps, and syringe pumps (13 models). All products are sold patient-ready with a six-month warranty unless otherwise noted.

Biomedix Medical’s customer base spans the healthcare industry, including emergency medical services, homecare providers, hospitals, and veterinary clinics. The company ships equipment throughout the United States, U.S. territories, Canada, and Mexico.

The company’s stated mission is to provide high-quality refurbished medical equipment to the healthcare industry at affordable prices while delivering great service for medical device repair.
